text: Round four's HOOMD-blue bundle (build-hoomd-hpmc-0001, template v9) was tested standing alone in run 20261116-8, collection 20261116-8/collect-1 on this computer; tasks/016 has the round. It did its start task, installed its environment, ran the tutorial, analysed, rendered and validated with nobody to ask, and gave the count with no verdict. Asked for a later template version, each as the session met it in the bundle's text: (1) the README names .claude/agents/, which a bundle without subagents does not carry; (2) CLAUDE.md speaks of safety values as null and says a file with no entry means no tool requires a gate, while envelope/safety.json is {} and every tool there requires a gate that envelope/execution_permission.json opens: say which file opens which gate; (3) CLAUDE.md forbids writes outside the folder, while the install tool lets pixi write its package cache in the home folder: either keep the cache inside the bundle's runs/ (the cache directory set by the adapter) or name that one write in CLAUDE.md and the tool's side effects; (4) the render tool returned frame -1 for the last frame while its contract types frame as a count: a sentinel needs its own declared value or a separate field, and the adapter's output should be read against its contract's outputs before it is returned; (5) validate_tasks.py makes run folders under runs/ and nothing in the bundle says so; (6) tasks/001 says the first two commands end with an OK line, while gate.py prints 'self-check ok'; (7) the bundle carries no table from which the grade of a number it reports is derived, so the session reported the count with its grade not derived: carry the grade rule the builder used, or say in CLAUDE.md that a reported value's grade is the builder's to derive. The bundle in run 8 is removed after this note is committed; the collection stays in the log folder.
